verdict.rationale: Eqvista is a SaaS platform that holds sensitive equity data, so user control over data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, no data or account deletion, and no retention policy. The advanced permissions feature controls who can view or modify data, which is a different control from retention or deletion and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
